def queue_cost(utilization: float) -> float:
    remaining = max(1.0 - utilization, 0.001)
    return utilization * utilization / remaining

def anchor_delay(neighbor: Pod, pod: Pod, future_node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    incoming = 0.0
    outgoing = 0.0
    for e in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        is_outgoing = False
        if source == neighbor.id:
            other = destination
            is_outgoing = True
        elif destination == neighbor.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and other != neighbor.id and ctx.graph.rate[e] > 0.0:
            anchor = ctx.pods[other]
            if anchor.current_node >= 0:
                anchor_node = ctx.nodes[anchor.current_node]
                delay = anchor_node.latency_to_ms[future_node.id]
                if is_outgoing:
                    delay = future_node.latency_to_ms[anchor.current_node]
                weighted = weighted + ctx.graph.rate[e] * delay
                weight = weight + ctx.graph.rate[e]
                if is_outgoing:
                    outgoing = max(outgoing, delay)
                else:
                    incoming = max(incoming, delay)
    if weight > 0.0:
        return 0.30 * weighted / weight + 0.35 * (incoming + outgoing)
    return 0.0

        neighbor_node = ctx.nodes[neighbor.current_node]

        if outgoing:
            latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]

        neighbor_mem = neighbor_node.mem_allocated
        if neighbor.current_node == node.id:
            neighbor_cpu = neighbor_cpu + pod.cpu_request
            neighbor_mem = neighbor_mem + pod.mem_request
        cpu_util = float(neighbor_cpu) / float(max(neighbor_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
        mem_util = float(neighbor_mem) / float(max(neighbor_node.mem_capacity, 1))
        return latency + 8.0 * queue_cost(max(cpu_util, mem_util))

    best = 1000000.0
    second = 1000000.0
    options = 0
    candidate_cpu = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    candidate_mem = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    candidate_pressure = queue_cost(max(candidate_cpu, candidate_mem))
    for n in range(len(ctx.nodes)):
        future_node = ctx.nodes[n]
        future_cpu = future_node.cpu_allocated + neighbor.cpu_request
        future_mem = future_node.mem_allocated + neighbor.mem_request
        if future_node.id == node.id:
            future_cpu = future_cpu + pod.cpu_request
            future_mem = future_mem + pod.mem_request
        cpu_util = float(future_cpu) / float(max(future_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
        mem_util = float(future_mem) / float(max(future_node.mem_capacity, 1))
        peak = max(cpu_util, mem_util)
        if not future_node.suspended and peak < 1.0:
            latency = future_node.latency_to_ms[node.id]
            if outgoing:
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[future_node.id]
            excess = max(peak - 0.65, 0.0)
            future_cost = latency + 8.0 * queue_cost(peak)
            future_cost = future_cost + 160.0 * excess * excess
            future_cost = future_cost + anchor_delay(neighbor, pod, future_node, ctx)
            if future_node.id == node.id:
                added_pressure = max(queue_cost(peak) - candidate_pressure, 0.0)
                future_cost = future_cost + 8.0 * added_pressure
            if future_cost < best:
                second = best
                best = future_cost
            else:
                second = min(second, future_cost)
            options = options + 1

    if options == 0:
        return 240.0
    if options == 1:
        return best + 8.0
    gap = min(max(second - best, 0.0), 40.0)
    return best + 0.20 * gap

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000000000.0

    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap

    high_excess = max(peak - 0.70, 0.0)
    pressure = 40.0 * peak_pressure + 14.0 * cpu_pressure
    pressure = pressure + 450.0 * excess * excess
    pressure = pressure + 2400.0 * high_excess * high_excess

    weighted_squared_latency = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    longest_latency = 0.0
    longest_incoming = 0.0
    longest_outgoing = 0.0
    for e in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        outgoing = False
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
            outgoing = True
        elif destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and ctx.graph.rate[e] > 0.0:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
            latency = dependency_delay(pod, neighbor, node, ctx, outgoing)
            weighted_latency = weighted_latency + rate * latency
            weighted_squared_latency = weighted_squared_latency + rate * latency * latency

    mean_latency = 0.0

    tail_latency = 0.0
    path_delay = 0.0
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean_latency = weighted_latency / weight
        mean_squared_latency = weighted_squared_latency / weight
        tail_latency = longest_latency
        path_delay = longest_incoming + longest_outgoing

    path_excess = max(path_delay - tail_latency, 0.0)

    network_cost = network_cost + 0.025 * mean_squared_latency
    network_cost = network_cost + 1.00 * path_excess
    network_cost = network_cost + 0.010 * path_delay * path_delay
    network_cost = network_cost + 0.30 * path_delay * cpu_pressure

    dynamic_range = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)

# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.

def resource_score(requested: int, capacity: int) -> int:
    if capacity == 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 0
    return ((capacity - requested) * 100) // capacity

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    cpu = resource_score(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request, node.cpu_capacity)
    mem = resource_score(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request, node.mem_capacity)
    return float((cpu + mem) // 2)
